notes: The only strong HORIZONTAL in the set. Rock is blocky, trees and grass are vertical, bushes are round — a meadow built from those alone reads as a repeating stamp, and one log lying across the slope breaks it. Collided with a single convex hull: a bowed tube is convex to within a few centimetres and a hull needs no canonical axis, which a lying log does not have.

rules.placement: Strong horizontal break across slope — scatter sparsely so meadows and shores do not read as a repeated stamp.
rules.avoid: Avoid dense rock fields where the horizontal read is lost.
